final: WITH combo_counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM combo_counts), compared AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share_minus_status_avg FROM shares) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share_minus_status_avg FROM compared WHERE share_minus_status_avg > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_status_avg DESC LIMIT 10
